Trigger.Name: VALIDATE_FIELD
Trigger.TriggerText:
declare
 present_reg_id varchar2(8);
 temp_reg_id varchar2(8);
 rgnt_cnt number(15);
 cur_rec number(2) := :system.cursor_record;
 present_kit_lot varchar2(10); 
begin
 /* Commented by Sobha per new requirements in Testing Module */
 /* if :global.user_testing_lab_code = '99' 
 then
 go_item('chk_out_tst');
 else*/

 nullchk;
 BEGIN
 select rsm.reagent_code, vr.reagent_name,
 vr.reagent_type, supplier_code,
 lot_number, kit_lot_number, 
 remaining_tests, reagent_id, 
 control_ind, max_storage_temp, 
 min_storage_temp, storage_location, 
 expiry_date, reagent_status, 
 vr.test_id, vr.master_lot_required
 into :test_kit_reagents3.reagent_code, :test_kit_reagents3.reagent_name,
 :test_kit_reagents3.reagent_type, :test_kit_reagents3.supplier_code,
 :test_kit_reagents3.lot_number, :test_kit_reagents3.kit_lot_number,
 :test_kit_reagents3.remaining_tests, :test_kit_reagents3.reagent_id,
 :test_kit_reagents3.control_ind, :test_kit_reagents3.max_storage_temp,
 :test_kit_reagents3.min_storage_temp, :test_kit_reagents3.storage_locn,
 :test_kit_reagents3.expiry_date, :test_kit_reagents3.reagent_status , 
 :test_kit_reagents3.test_id, :test_kit_reagents3.mst_lot_req 
 from reagent_store_mst rsm, valid_reagents vr 
 where rsm.chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id 
 and reagent_id = :test_kit_reagents3.reagent_id
 and rsm.test_id = :ctrl_blk_1.s_test_id 
 and rsm.test_id = vr.test_id
 and rsm.reagent_code = vr.reagent_code
 and reagent_status in ('P','S') 
 and (lab_code = :global.user_testing_lab_code 
 or :global.user_testing_lab_code = '99')
 and remaining_tests >= 0 
 and visual_qc_flag = 'Y' 
 and vr.reagent_type in ('R','C') 
 and preparation_flag in ('P','N')
 and nvl(kit_lot_number,'!!!') = decode(vr.master_lot_required,
 'Y',nvl(:GLOBAL.kit_lot,nvl(kit_lot_number,'!!!')), nvl(kit_lot_number,'!!!'))
 and sysdate between eff_date and nvl(term_date,sysdate)
 and vr.prequalification_flag = 'Y';
 IF :GLOBAL.kit_lot is null and :mst_lot_req = 'Y' THEN
 :GLOBAL.kit_lot := :test_kit_reagents3.kit_lot_number; 
 END IF;
 present_reg_id := :test_kit_reagents3.reagent_id;
 if :prep_by is null and :prep_date is null then
 :prep_by := :banner.user_id;
 :prep_date := sysdate;
 end if;
 EXCEPTION
 when no_data_found then
 show_error('2300');
 check_package_failure;
 END;
 begin
 go_record(1);
 while :system.last_record = 'FALSE' 
 loop
 temp_reg_id := :test_kit_reagents3.reagent_id;
 if temp_reg_id = present_reg_id then
 down;
 show_error('2324');
 else
 down;
 end if;
 end loop;
 end;
 begin
 nullchk;
 check_package_failure;
 if :test_kit_reagents3.reagent_type not in ('R','C','K','U')
 then
 show_error('1900');
 check_package_failure;
 else
 begin
 if :supplier_code IS NOT NULL then
 select supplier_name 
 into :supplier_name 
 from suppliers
 where supplier_code = :test_kit_reagents3.supplier_code;
 end if;
 exception
 when no_data_found then
 show_error('4019') ;
 when others then
 handle_error; 
 end;
 go_item('chk_out_tst');
 end if;
 end;
 -- end if;
exception
 when others then
 handle_error;
end;

Trigger.Name: VALIDATE_RECORD
Trigger.TriggerText:
declare
 kitnu varchar(12);
 r_typ varchar(5);
 no_rs number(1);
 begin
 go_record(1);
 if :system.last_record = 'TRUE' then
 show_error('1818');
 else
 KITNU := :kit_lot_number;
 while :system.last_record = 'FALSE'
 loop
 if :kit_lot_number != KITNU then
 show_error('3302');
 check_package_failure;
 exit;
 else
 down;
 end if;
 end loop;
 if :system.last_record = 'TRUE' then
 if :kit_lot_number != KITNU then 
 show_error('3302');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 end if;
 end if;
 r_typ := :reagent_type;
 go_record(1);
 while :system.last_record = 'FALSE' loop
 if :reagent_type = r_typ then
 no_rs := 1;
 down;
 else
 no_rs := 3;
 exit;
 end if;
 end loop;
 if :system.last_record = 'TRUE' and no_rs = 1 and :reagent_type = r_typ then
 show_error('1818');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 exception
 when others then 
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;

ProgramUnit.Name: UPDATE_QUANTITY
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE update_quantity IS
 rem_tst number(10);
 ck_quan number(10) := 0;
 new_quan number(10);
 new_rem number(10);
 prev_quan number(10);
begin
 go_record(1);
 loop 
 select remaining_tests
 into rem_tst from reagent_store_mst 
 where reagent_id = :test_kit_reagents3.reagent_id
 and chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id;
 begin 
 select chk_out_tst 
 into ck_quan from usable_reagents
 where reagent_id = :test_kit_reagents3.reagent_id 
 and test_kit_id = :s_test_kit_id;
 exception
 when no_data_found then 
 ck_quan := 0; 
 end; 
 if :test_kit_reagents3.chk_out_tst < 0 or 
 :test_kit_reagents3.chk_out_tst is null then
 show_error('2319');
 end if;
 new_rem := ck_quan + rem_tst - :test_kit_reagents3.chk_out_tst;
 if :test_kit_reagents3.chk_out_tst > :test_kit_reagents3.remaining_tests
 then
 show_error('2325');
 end if;
 update reagent_store_mst 
 set remaining_tests = new_rem
 where reagent_id = :test_kit_reagents3.reagent_id
 and chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id; 
 exit when :system.last_record = 'TRUE';
 down;
 end loop;
exception
 when others then
 handle_error;
end;
